Equipment
 H2-Compressors plants
 REC 2 stages water cooled
 Fluitron serial no : 9712-7871
 Fluitron kanda

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, to be performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The H2 compressors 
 are used to supply the H2 station to cooling generator.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdullah Hussein, reviewed by 
 eng. Mostafa elnahal: maintenance manager, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, 
 accepted by general manager eng. Ahmed abd elrahman, and approved by eng. 
 Mahmoud el nakeb; head sector of Ayon Mousa PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel 
 Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
 coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC 
 planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of 
 this compressor.

Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the 
 motor of this compressor.

The H2 compressor must be purged by N2 then 
 air.
Close the cooling water supply.
No smoking.
Complete maintenance tool set.

Cleaning articles (fluid, rags, soft brushes. 
 etc)
Manual puller, Feeler gauge,
Compressed air supply.
Spray gun

Visually inspect all diaphragms (three diaphragms for each stage, beside gas 
 and oil 301 ss diaphragm in the middle brass diaphragm ,its dimensions is the 
 same 27 7/8 od x .016) and replace if 
 necessary.
Remove the housing cover.
Remove the top seal plate.
Remove broken diaphragm.

When inspecting the check valve, look for: rust, broken springs, damaged 
 seals, freedom of movement
Repair or replace as necessary and reinstall discharge check valve

Inspecting and look 
 for broken spring damaged seal

Visually inspect and replace the oil filter element. A single line type oil 
 filter is furnished consisting of a 10 micron replaceable cartridge element.
Visually inspect the oil cooler tubes:

Match mark and remove bonnets from oil cooler and inspect zinc anode for 
 erosion for oxide deposits. Scrape to brighten surface and replace if more 
 than half is corroded away.

Carefully examine tubes for scale and clean if necessary .After cleaning, 
 examine for erosion or corrosion.

After maintenance inspection or cleaning, both shell and tube side should be 
 carefully vented and full of liquid.

Visually inspect the oil mist arrestor. Clean the housing and replace the. 
 element if saturated.

Take oil sample and analyze against Ingersoil-Rand oil Specification Replace 
 oil if necessary
Rotate the bull gear by hand and feel for roughness in the bearings.
Visually inspect the coupling. Lubricate if necessary.
Remove and clean the condensate trap.

Check function of 
 pressure gauges and thermometers, recalibrate if necessary. Clean thermometer 
 pockets.
